label: Chimerarachne-inspired tailed arachnid
label_zh: 奇美拉蛛灵感尾鞭蛛形动物
scope: Original stylized child-friendly scene prop inspired by inventory taxon. Not scientific reconstruction. No inventory approval or publication.
design: Low domed front body, narrow waist, oval visibly segmented abdomen and long slender gently curved whip-like tail; eight articulated walking legs in four pairs, two smaller simple pedipalps at front, subtle rear underside spinneret projections. Warm walnut/russet/sand palette, modest natural dark eyes. No scorpion sting, pincers, horror spikes or web.
concept_interpretation: Concept pedipalps too large and some legs overlap. Author exactly eight well-separated walking legs plus visibly shorter simple pedipalps; smooth a few abdomen plate transitions, preserve segmentation. Spinnerets simplified. Tail curvature, colour and eye placement artistic; no sex-exact or taxonomic placement assertion.

budgets.runtime_target: Three.js0.180.0; parent independent parse/GPU/scene QA pending

coverage: Eight geometric directions plus clay/alternate key/wire. Static candidate only; pending independent QA.
critical_obligations: Independent identifying silhouette; real body volume and closed thick appendages
Anatomical paired landmark counts stated in design
Source, export and separately executed rebuild parity
Exact exported GLB multi-angle pixels inspected
Honest stylized claim limits and pending external gates
